    Recorded SEND cadence → watch RECEIVE

    22 copies of 7A 06 F0 over about 14.31 seconds. Start records only; the RECEIVE mark starts the series once. Any RX after TX pauses the remaining repeats while recording continues.

    Planned triples
    The cadence uses USB timestamps. The adapter sends normal SIR bytes, without reproducing hypothetical stretched start bits or source byte gaps. All received bytes, including possible echo, are preserved.
    

    Automatic receiver comparison
    Receiver settingSamplesMost repeated bytesRepeatability
    The page compares unmodified bursts without requiring 7A 06 F0. A stable output is a candidate, not proof of correct decoding. No bytes are sent to the watch.
    

    Previously received bytes  
    One contiguous transmission. No added framing, CRC, acknowledgements or repeats. Use the same bytes for the control and watch test.
